main_story.headline: Dungeon Muster at Widmoria as the Region Reckons With Its Pyramid
main_story.lede: An evening expedition assembled itself in open chat while a newcomer's question about high-tier work got the same answer from every direction: the base of the pyramid is always Tier 1.
main_story.body:
The evening's main event assembled itself over an hour of open chat. **Aryn** put out the call, "im ready for dungeon crawls when everyone else is," and directions followed for anyone who needed them: "the widmoria dungeon is just southeast of grand exchange," with **TinyHouseGamer** placing it northwest of the Ranch. The roster sorted itself out in public. **Archaelic** confessed, "Would love to join, just dont have any plate." and was told a bow and a place in the back would do. **Aryn** declared for *dps claymore*, with a caveat for the bigger runs: "ill come for t7s, but i gotta stick with xbow lol".

Assembly was not without friction. **Lilitha** and **Archaelic** were already inside while others were still travelling, prompting **Aryn** to ask, "can you wait for the rest of us pls :))". **Akela** kept vigil at the entrance, "Im just chillin at the entrance, grabbing more coffee," and **MezTheMirewarden** summed up the mood of a crew off its home turf: "I don't know these waters!" **Tyburn** arrived at the arrangement with a question nobody rushed to answer: "Wait, you guys didnt have to pay aryn and tiny?"

Behind the outing sits a real ambition. **TinyHouseGamer** noted that "damn R9 is doing T7 dungeons atm", and **Ariakan** laid the region's position out plainly: "im all for running t7s here domesctically, just hard to gather people with our pop". **Aryn** remembered the last campaign in less romantic terms: "felt like i was at war". The appetite has not dimmed. Toward midnight **Argent Ore** was asking "just in general any events planned for tonight?" and **KeyserSoze** stood ready: "let me know if you are gonna make the attempt and I'll tp down".

The day's other seminar was economics. **Cyxlinux**, new to the region and sitting at tier 3, wondered whether anyone would want tier 8 or 9 hunters someday. The answer came from all sides and it was unanimous. "not a lot atm - most ppl need mass amounts of t1-3," said **Bloggs**. **Peanuts** supplied the theory: "its a pyramid , every time the pyramid gets bigger, but the base of the pyramid is always Tier1". **HereticalSage** did the arithmetic, "so in the end game you need thousands of t1s", leaving **Cyxlinux** to conclude, "i see, so the entire world have nothing to offer? lol". **JellyCatBee** found the silver lining: "This is probably the only case were are job offers for experience are actually acceptable".

The pyramid's base was well fed regardless. The boards ran their usual ticker: **ChickenBake** posted "350k forestry at sages of the mines", **Sinklar** reported "300k T1 smithing remains at RRR" with 1.2 million already down, and **HereticalSage** advertised both "80k t3 farming at sanctuary" and "100k t1 smithing at sanctuary". **Aryn** ran a side operation in learning, "making codexes at the bungalow if anyone wants some scholar xp!", and the task reset countdowns arrived on schedule from **Archaelic** and **Hydra**, as dependable as any clock the region owns.

Wayfinding filled the gaps between. **Toczys** went looking for a harvest ground and got a committee: **IgnisRoman** and **MezTheMirewarden** offered routes through the autumn forest and toward argent city, while **HereticalSage** endorsed the jungle road near port spire for its road and lamps. **Akela** asked, "is there a good amount of t4 lake fish near galore?" and **Aryn** pointed up the western coast of the autumn forest, where the tier 4 fish were in no short supply. **Astralite** had a subtraction request instead: "can someone come remove a t7 sand for us at argent city please?"

There was history, too. When **caffeine** asked whether **Talis** still plays, **HereticalSage** delivered the region's shortest war memoir: "he threathened me for land when i just started my settlement so i had to give it to him", and then, "when i got build up, i took it back and he quit".

The mood around all of it stayed distinctly local. The chant of "THE ORE PROVIDES" rang out at intervals from **Auric Ore**, **Argent Ore**, **Astralite**, and **Sorata**, and **Sorata** returned from travels far and wide bearing the secret world formula to life, "which is.... 67", a revelation **Auric Ore** received as "A PROPHECY FORETOLD IN CRYPTIC NUMBERING". The mystery of the missing rum closed when **Aryn** admitted it was "in mah belleh". **Omakase** filed the day's complaint, "i feel like the view storage bug is even worse now", and **Scun** offered the loner's benediction: "the life of a solo is ever dismal". On the evidence of the day's chat, few here are at risk of finding out.

announcements.title: Aryn Ramps Up Scholar Codex Production
announcements.summary: **Aryn** has been making codexes at the bungalow, working through 45k of tier 1 scholar output and preparing to move on to tier 2. The invitation went out to anyone chasing scholar xp: come help speed up OFG's upgrade for everyone's benefit.

announcements.title: KeyserSoze Hits Sailing Level 75
announcements.summary: **KeyserSoze** logged sailing at level 75, another quiet marker in the region's ongoing skill climb.

announcements.title: Sorata Uncovers the Secret World Formula
